args.description: a single ancient Greek double-headed bronze axe head mounted upright on top of a short wooden post planted in the floor, the round hole of the axe head clearly open and visible through the blade so an arrow could pass through it, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile. Drawn small enough that the post base and the whole blade are complete and visible. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the axe and its post. Palette of polished bronze and dark oak. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
